title: NASA-UAP-VM005, Apollo 12, 1969
what_is_it: An official NASA archival photograph (still image) of the lunar surface, annotated by the releasing agency to highlight areas of interest.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text — all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the CSV blurb, not from the document itself.
The 'unidentified phenomena' framing and the highlighted areas were added by the releasing agency; NASA explicitly states the highlighting is not an analytical judgment or factual determination.

Highlighted spots on scanned lunar photographs are commonly film artefacts, dust, lens flare, or emulsion defects rather than genuine objects; the document offers no analysis supporting a UAP interpretation.
Single-source, image-only release with no accompanying investigative report or provenance for the annotations.

verifiable_claims.claim: The photograph was taken from the Apollo 12 landing site on the Moon in 1969.
